title: M5StickC PLUS2 breadboard jig: resistor + LED + button
notes: Firmware (jig/firmware) classifies led from a forward and a reverse test at the sense row, checking the resistor first, and reports a state only after 3 matching readings. button_rotated is only watched on the step where the button is placed (pressed while nobody presses it = rotated 90 degrees). Thresholds are set by measurement (C).
